description: This file implements the business logic layer for cart operations in an e-commerce system. It defines APIs for retrieving, updating, adding, removing, and clearing items in a user's shopping cart, with validation, error handling, and total recalculation.

classes.name: CartServiceError
classes.description: Base exception class for cart service errors.

classes.name: InvalidCartDataError
classes.description: Exception indicating invalid input or data validation failures.

methods.name: CartResponse get_user_cart(user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a user's cart, recalculates totals, and returns a cart response object.

methods.name: CartResponse add_item_to_cart(user_id: str, item_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Validates input, creates or updates cart items, recalculates totals, and returns updated cart.

methods.name: CartResponse update_cart_item(user_id: str, product_id: str, quantity: int)
methods.description: Updates the quantity of an existing cart item, with validation and total recalculation.

methods.name: CartResponse remove_cart_item(user_id: str, product_id: str)
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart, then recalculates totals.

methods.name: CartResponse clear_user_cart(user_id: str)
methods.description: Empties the user’s cart, preserving cart structure, and recalculates totals.

ctags.name: add_item_to_cart
ctags.pattern: /^async def add_item_to_cart(user_id: str, item_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> CartResponse:$/

ctags.name: remove_cart_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def remove_cart_item(user_id: str, product_id: str) -> CartResponse:$/

ctags.name: update_cart_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_cart_item(user_id: str, product_id: str, quantity: int) -> CartResponse:$/
